entities.summary: Nikolai Mikhailovich Amosov, Doctor of Science, Professor, also known as Mykola Mykhailovych Amosov was a Soviet and Ukrainian doctor of Russian origin, heart surgeon, inventor, best-selling author, and exercise enthusiast, known for his inventions of several surgical procedures for treating heart defects.
